artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the small cassette label is blurred and illegible. While expected due to image resolution, AI often fails to render even placeholder text correctly here, resulting in smudged artifacts rather than distinct characters.
The knobs and buttons on the stereo deck have a slightly 'waxy' or overly smooth texture lacking the fine machining marks or dust accumulation expected in a realistic product photo.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object inserted in the deck is taxonomically classified as a 'cassette' and not a similar rectangular object.
To analyze the legibility of the large header text and the potential gibberish on the cassette label.
To ensure the cassette is a single coherent object and not merging with the deck slot (fusion artifact).

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the cassette within the deck slot
Legibility and coherence of text elements
Geometric correctness of the cassette windows and spools
